claim: Demo resets to its own sample data.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; change a release ring; reset; assert seeded package returns and only the demo namespace is used

claim: The demo opens three complete skill packages and their review records.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert exactly three named packages and each package's approval, source, and instructions

claim: Leaving the demo deletes its sample workspace.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; reset, choose Start for real, and assert the demo storage key is absent

claim: Receipts preserve the exact package version.
where: landing fact and registry receipt form
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record a run; assert selected version, digest, and repository appear in the receipt table

claim: Sample data stays in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record outgoing origins during reset and assert only the product origin; set offline and assert the sample UI remains visible

claim: Pilot and full release require a recorded review.
where: landing release path and registry release control
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; publish an unreviewed exact version; try pilot; assert it stays draft and explains the required review

claim: A downloaded package contains its exact instructions, adapter content, Git commit, version, digest, and signature.
where: landing release path and registry package detail
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download assigned package; parse JSON and assert the complete immutable fields

claim: Real workspaces require a workspace owner key and isolate their records.
where: landing facts, registry start, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh server and database; assert unauthenticated reads fail, a second workspace cannot read the first, and both may use the same package id

claim: A separate recovery key replaces a lost workspace owner key.
where: registry start, privacy, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh server and database; create a workspace, confirm both raw keys are absent from SQLite, recover, and assert the old owner key fails while the new key works

claim: The API accepts uppercase secret reference names and rejects other formats.
where: landing privacy section and privacy route
sandbox: fresh server and database; submit a secret-like value and assert HTTP 400, then submit GITHUB_TOKEN and assert creation succeeds

claim: Published packages are loaded from one verified GitHub JSON file and signed with its blob identifier.
where: README, landing release path, registry package detail
sandbox: fresh server with a recorded GitHub verifier fixture; reject invented source; ignore forged submitted instruction fields; assert the signed payload records the verified source path and blob identifier

claim: A reviewer can inspect and approve one package without a workspace owner key, and the reviewer key works once.
sandbox: fresh server; fetch and approve with only the package reviewer key; assert the workspace owner key cannot review and reuse returns 401

claim: A receipt is issued only for an assigned agent and repository after an approved package enters pilot or full release.
where: README, registry receipt form, landing release path
sandbox: fresh server; reject draft, review-ring, wrong-agent, and wrong-repository receipts; assert accepted receipt contains approval, package signature, and receipt signature

claim: Pilot releases reach only their named pilot repositories; full release reaches every assigned repository.
sandbox: fresh server; approve a two-repository package, enter pilot, assert the non-pilot repository is forbidden, then release to all and assert it can install

claim: An install credential reads only one package for one repository and agent.
sandbox: fresh server; issue one scoped credential and assert the workspace owner key cannot install, the credential cannot administer, and wrong repository or agent is rejected

claim: Each assigned agent can download a repository-native instruction file with signed package provenance.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; choose web-console and Claude Code, download CLAUDE.md, and assert shared instructions, adapter instructions, repository, digest, and install command

claim: Each trusted client IP has its own 40-request limit.
sandbox: fresh server; exhaust one first X-Forwarded-For hop, assert a second hop succeeds, then assert the first receives 429 with Retry-After

claim: A workspace can verify a private GitHub package through a deployment-managed credential reference bound to one repository.
sandbox: fresh server with a fixture credential; bind PRIVATE_GITHUB to one workspace repository, publish its private package, then assert cross-workspace and cross-repository reads fail and the token is absent from SQLite

claim: The trust endpoint returns the signer key and its matching SHA-256 fingerprint.
sandbox: fresh server; fetch /api/trust, hash the returned public key bytes, and assert the fingerprint matches

claim: PORT changes the service listener.
sandbox: start the release binary on a selected free port and reach /health on that port

claim: DATABASE_PATH selects the SQLite and signing-state directory.
sandbox: start the release binary with a temporary explicit database path and assert the database and signing key are created beside it

claim: A mounted data directory preserves workspace access and the signing identity across restarts.
sandbox: fresh server using a temporary data directory; create a workspace, restart with the same directory, and assert workspace access and signer fingerprint persist

claim: The self-hosted build is available under the MIT license.
sandbox: fresh clone; complete the production frontend build, assert LICENSE is MIT, and assert the Dockerfile includes locked frontend and backend production builds

claim: The researched managed plan is $149 per team each month, but billing is not active in this release.
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the exact price, inactive-billing notice, and absence of checkout or payment controls
